description: Command-driven proof sweep for the 6 elemental reactions. Each command applies two different-element marks to a synthetic target and reports the ReactionResult (name, bonus damage %, applied status effects): Storm Surge (aero+hydro +12%), Mud Snare (hydro+terra +10%), Dust Cyclone (aero+terra +10%), Black Steam (corruptus+hydro +11%), Gravebind (corruptus+terra +12%), Hellstorm (aero+corruptus +14%).
commands: motm dev passive reaction aero hydro
motm dev passive reaction hydro terra
motm dev passive reaction aero terra
motm dev passive reaction corruptus hydro
motm dev passive reaction corruptus terra
motm dev passive reaction aero corruptus
